result.description: Generative AI image/video platform (Soul, Seedance and about 40 other models) with a pay-per-generation REST API, CLI and hosted MCP.
result.auth_detail: REST API: key ID + secret pair from the Higgsfield Console, sent as `Authorization: Key ID:SECRET` (legacy hf-api-key/hf-secret headers also work). Server-side only. Hosted MCP/CLI use a browser sign-in with the user's own Higgsfield account. No third-party OAuth app registration documented for the REST API.
result.access_detail: Gate audit (1): no app review, listing or partner status is documented. Each end user creates their own key pair in the Console, which does not count as a gate. Gate audit (2): no subscription or paid plan is required. Billing is pay-per-generation against an account balance, so generation needs credits (the launch offer asks for a card and $15). The pricing page was truncated, so "no subscriptions" and "no manual review" come from a summary and are not verified quotes. Key creation is free and the playground is reportedly free.
result.api_notes: Base URL https://api.higgsfield.ai, with an OpenAPI-generated reference. Per-model generation endpoints (for example POST /higgsfield-ai/soul/v2/standard and POST /bytedance/seedance-2.0/text-to-video), about 42 models mostly image and video. Shared endpoints for request status and cancel (GET /requests/{id}/status). Python SDK higgsfield-client. Generation-focused, with no account-management objects. I did not read the full endpoint list.
result.blocker: Usage needs a funded credit balance. Keys are server-side only with no third-party OAuth, so end users must paste their own key pair. Narrow generation-only surface.

evidence.quote: Each credential consists of a key ID and a secret.
Do not call the API directly from browser or mobile application code.
API credentials grant access to your account and its balance.
